ensemble_method: original Hybrid-K soft voting: unweighted mean of raw member softmax probabilities, log(clip(p, 1e-12)) pseudo-logits, one ensemble temperature
temperature_fit: same fold and seed calibration subset only; exact log-sum-exp NLL; beta=1/T in [0.2, 4.0]; T=1 guard
original_calibrate_best_step: not used (it selected raw vs calibrated using ECE on the evaluated fold, i.e. test labels); T always applied

baselines.Best single (composite): rank 1 of the saved composite ranking per fold
baselines.Accuracy Top-K / Best single (accuracy): seed-averaged calibration accuracy per fold (crossfit_composite/normalized_metrics_per_fold.csv), stable tie-break in original model order
baselines.All-9 equal-weight: original soft voting over all nine models

equal_weight_note: the original Hybrid-K voting is already equal-weight; no separate weighted variant exists
nll: exact NLL of softmax(pseudo_logits / T) via log-sum-exp
sd: sample SD (ddof=1) over the 15 units; units share test images across seeds, so they are not independent
